title: Scenario 2: write and render a flowchart (self-corrects on a PostScript error)
prompt: Using the pscat-render tools, draw a flowchart of how this server handles a render request: the agent sends PostScript, the request is validated, a "Within limits?" decision either returns a structured error or renders in a worker, and the result comes back as PNG/PDF/SVG. Use labelled boxes and arrows, Helvetica text. Show me the rendered image.
notes: showpage is not required: render_postscript returns the current page of a program that never calls it (#44 triage).
